now.title: What we’re trying to achieve
now.says: Keep the customers we have, and get paid on time.

now.title: Why it matters
now.says: Late payments are costing us more than lost orders. Cash, not sales, is what is holding us back.

now.title: What we currently believe
now.says: Customers pay late mostly when something went wrong after the sale. This is a belief we are testing.

now.title: What we’ve learned so far
now.says: Of 14 late payers, 9 had a problem with delivery or installation first.

now.title: What matters most right now
now.says: Hearing about unhappy customers before payment is due.

now.title: Who owns what
now.says: Amani owns the direction. Wairimu owns sales, Lucy delivery, Grace collections.

whatChanged.label: What we assumed.
whatChanged.says: More sales would fix our cash.

whatChanged.label: What showed it wasn’t true.
whatChanged.says: Sales grew 12% in August, but cash in the bank fell.

whatChanged.label: What we learned.
whatChanged.says: Late payments, not too few sales, are the problem. Most late payers had a problem after the sale.

whatChanged.label: What we decided.
whatChanged.says: Move from winning new customers to keeping and getting paid by the ones we have.

whatChanged.label: The new direction.
whatChanged.says: Keep the customers we have, and get paid on time.

teams.title: Sales
teams.says: Ask about payment history before promising terms. Fewer new small accounts this quarter.

teams.title: Delivery
teams.says: Tell finance the same day when a customer is unhappy.

teams.title: Finance
teams.says: Call about the fridge before calling about the money.

teams.title: Operations
teams.says: Check stock before sales promises a date. This depends on sales sharing orders a day earlier.

realigned.title: Teams that have not agreed what it means for them
Commitments that no longer make sense
realigned.says: Miriam’s target, 20 new small shops a month, is still on the board, though Sales's brief stops it. It is suggested to them as one to stop or change.

realigned.title: Goals nobody has looked at since the change
realigned.says: Miriam’s target, 20 new small shops a month, has not been continued, changed or stopped yet.
